name: html-disassembler
description: An Arm, x86, WebAssembly, .NET and Java disassembler in one offline HTML file: macOS Mach-O (arm64, x86_64), Linux and Android ELF (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86, APK), wasm modules, .NET assemblies (CIL) and Java classes and JARs (JVM bytecode), instructions explained, statistics and an HLA64 view

scripts.test: node tools/wasm.mjs --quiet && node tools/wasm-opcodes.mjs --check && cargo test -q -p disasm-core && node tests/decode.mjs && node tests/encode.mjs && node tests/arm32.mjs && node tests/x86.mjs && node tests/wasm.mjs && node tests/cil.mjs && node tests/jvm.mjs && node tests/elf.mjs && node tests/patch.mjs && node tests/macho.mjs && node tests/ios.mjs && node tests/winarm.mjs && node tests/demangle.mjs && node tests/hla.mjs && node tests/data.mjs && node tests/i18n.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
